function.arguments: {"observation": "`species` and `island` are strongly associated (up to 64% departure from the overall rate).", "implication": "This is a confounding relationship. However, the estimand is the Pearson correlation between two continuous variables (`flipper_length_mm` and `body_mass_g`) across all penguins. The presence of a confounder (island) does not bias the Pearson correlation coefficient itself — it is a descriptive statistic of the joint distribution. The correlation is not causal, so confounding does not distort it in the way it would a causal effect estimate. Therefore, we can compute the overall correlation without stratification or adjustment."}
function.name: note_finding
